decision_conditions: The proposed variation of condition to allow an increase in people and car parking spaces, fails to provide an acceptable level of off street parking, thus would give rise to an unacceptable amount of on street parking demand that would prejudice the availability of existing on street parking spaces and have a negative impact on the access and servicing arrangements for the neighbouring industrial units, as well as wider implications in regards to functioning and safety of the highway network to the adjoining roads, including Montagu Road. The proposal is therefore contrary to the NPPF (2024), Policies T6 and T6.1 of the London Plan (2021), Policies CP24 and CP25 of the Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD35, DMD45, DMD46, DMD47 and DMD48 of the Development Management Document.

The proposal by reason of its increased activity associated with additional people would by reason of the increased noise, disturbance and activity be harmful to the amenities enjoyed by the residents of the neighbouring properties, contrary to the NPPF (2024), Policy D14 of the London Plan 2021; Core Policies 30 and 32 of the Enfield Core Strategy 2010 and Policies DMD35, DMD37 and DMD68 of the Development Management Document (2014).
